integrity: The all-size assertions are proved by a case split of clique population thresholds and frozen adjacent path pairs. The standalone Python program checks all 768032 labelled configurations in 53 finite graphs, but those finite tests are not substituted for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple lollipop graphs only: clique size at least three, pendant path length at least two, synchronous open-neighborhood binary majority with retained ties. No results for changed updating, stochastic protocols or other graph attachments. Historical overlap search is bounded; independent validation has not occurred.
title: Parity-sharp voting times and maximal-delay census for lollipop majority dynamics
